level_b.baseline_construction_method: Sector-level SEC is compared with base-year SEC using an equation adjusted from ODEX and multiplied by production; only facilities reporting energy data for every year from 2010 through 2013 are included.
implementation_barriers: some DFBS do not have energy manager
the lack of strictness of law enforcement
the lack of awareness of facility’s owner
normalisation_variables: production, by weight or volume basis

performance_metrics_reported.evidence_quote:
